<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#142d27">
<title>Necias T Bisnar Jr. | H.E. Portfolio</title>
<style>
:root{--forest:#142d27;--green:#315c4b;--sage:#b9c9ae;--cream:#f5f1e7;--paper:#fffdf7;--gold:#d7a95b;--ink:#20332c;--muted:#6c786f;--line:#dce3d7}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}
button,a{font:inherit}.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;background:rgba(20,45,39,.97);color:#fff;padding:0 5vw;box-shadow:0 8px 24px #142d2720}
.navwrap{max-width:1200px;margin:auto;min-height:76px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px}
.brand{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:21px;letter-spacing:.4px;white-space:nowrap}.brand span{color:var(--gold)}
.navlinks{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.navlinks button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#dfe9df;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
.navlinks button:hover,.navlinks button.active{background:var(--gold);color:#1e3028}
.menu{display:none;border:1px solid #71877c;background:transparent;color:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px}
main{max-width:1200px;margin:auto;padding:34px 5vw 60px}
.page{display:none;animation:enter .35s ease}.page.active{display:block}
@keyframes enter{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.eyebrow{color:var(--green);font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2.5px;text-transform:uppercase}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;font-weight:500;margin:0;color:var(--forest)}
h1{font-size:clamp(43px,7vw,82px);line-height:.98;letter-spacing:-2px}h2{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,52px);margin:10px 0 18px}h3{font-size:25px;margin-bottom:10px}
p{line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 14px}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:55px;align-items:center;min-height:calc(100vh - 150px);padding:24px 0 50px}
.hero-copy .eyebrow{margin-bottom:22px}.hero-copy h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--green)}
.hero-copy .lead{font-size:17px;max-width:520px;margin:24px 0}
.actions{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:25px}
.btn{border:1px solid var(--forest);border-radius:4px;padding:13px 19px;background:var(--forest);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;transition:.2s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:var(--green)}.btn.outline{background:transparent;color:var(--forest)}
.photo-frame{position:relative;max-width:470px;margin-left:auto;padding:0 0 22px 22px}
.photo-frame:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:22px 0 0 0;border:1px solid var(--gold);z-index:0}
.photo-frame img{position:relative;z-index:1;width:100%;height:min(68vh,590px);object-fit:cover;object-position:center 35%;display:block;box-shadow:0 18px 45px #142d2720}
.photo-note{position:absolute;z-index:2;bottom:0;left:0;background:var(--gold);padding:12px 18px;color:var(--forest);font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:17px}
.pagehead{padding:30px 0 26px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:30px}
.pagehead p{max-width:680px}.grid2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px}
.grid3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}
.panel{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:25px;box-shadow:0 10px 28px #142d2708}
.panel .number{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:var(--gold);font-size:30px;margin-bottom:12px}
.panel p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}.tag{display:inline-block;background:#e8eee4;color:var(--green);padding:7px 10px;margin:4px 4px 0 0;font-size:12px;border-radius:2px}
.skill{margin:18px 0}.skilltop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px}.track{height:8px;background:#e3e8df}.fill{height:100%;width:var(--w);background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--green),var(--gold))}
.workcard{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:24px;min-height:190px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}
.workcard small{letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--gold);font-weight:800}.workcard p{font-size:14px}
.timeline{border-left:2px solid var(--gold);padding-left:22px;margin:18px 0}.timeline .item{position:relative;margin:0 0 24px}.timeline .item:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-29px;top:6px;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);border:3px solid var(--cream)}
.resume-line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.resume-line strong{color:var(--forest)}
.contactgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr;gap:20px}.contactform label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--green);margin:13px 0 6px}
input,textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;padding:13px;font:inherit;color:var(--ink);border-radius:3px}textarea{min-height:130px;resize:vertical}
footer{text-align:center;color:#8a958b;font-size:12px;padding:22px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.backtop{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:35px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
@media(max-width:850px){.navwrap{min-height:68px}.menu{display:block}.navlinks{display:none;position:absolute;top:68px;left:0;right:0;background:var(--forest);padding:12px 5vw 18px;box-shadow:0 12px 18px #0002;justify-content:flex-start}.navlinks.open{display:flex}.navlinks button{width:calc(50% - 6px);text-align:left}.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:35px;min-height:auto;padding-top:40px}.photo-frame{margin:0 auto;width:min(100%,480px)}.photo-frame img{height:520px}.grid3{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:560px){main{padding:22px 5vw 45px}.grid2,.grid3,.contactgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.panel{padding:20px}.photo-frame img{height:440px}.brand{font-size:18px}.resume-line{display:block}.resume-line span{display:block;margin-top:5px}}

/* English Literary Portfolio inside My Works */
.literary-portfolio{margin-top:22px}
.literary-cover{background:var(--forest);color:#fff;padding:30px;border-left:5px solid var(--gold);margin-bottom:20px}
.literary-cover .eyebrow{color:var(--sage)}
.literary-cover h3{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(25px,4vw,36px);margin:10px 0}
.literary-cover p{color:#e4ece4;margin:4px 0}
.literary-section{background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:clamp(20px,3vw,30px);margin:16px 0;box-shadow:0 10px 28px #142d2708}
.literary-section .section-label{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--green);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:10px}
.literary-section h3{margin-bottom:5px}
.literary-section .work-subtitle{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:var(--gold);font-style:italic;margin-bottom:18px}
.literary-copy{color:var(--ink);line-height:1.9;white-space:normal}
.literary-copy p{color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 13px;line-height:1.9}
.literary-poem{text-align:center;max-width:650px;margin:0 auto;color:var(--ink);font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:17px;line-height:2}
.literary-divider{border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin:22px 0}
.literary-end{text-align:center;background:#e8eee4;padding:20px;color:var(--green);font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:19px}

</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="topbar">
 <div class="navwrap">
  <div class="brand">NECIAS <span>·</span> H.E. PORTFOLIO</div>
  <button class="menu" id="menuBtn" aria-label="Open navigation">☰ Menu</button>
  <nav class="navlinks" id="navLinks" aria-label="Main navigation">
   <button class="active" data-page="home">Home</button>
   <button data-page="about">About Me</button>
   <button data-page="skills">H.E. Skills</button>
   <button data-page="works">My Works</button>
   <button data-page="projects">Projects</button>
   <button data-page="reflection">Reflection</button>
   <button data-page="resume">Resume</button>
   <button data-page="contact">Contact</button>
  </nav>
 </div>
</header>
<main>
<section class="page active" id="home">
 <div class="hero">
  <div class="hero-copy">
   <div class="eyebrow">Home Economics · Student Portfolio</div>
   <h1>Learning today.<br><em>Creating for life.</em></h1>
   <p class="lead">Hello! I am <strong style="color:var(--forest)">Necias T Bisnar Jr.</strong> Welcome to my Home Economics portfolio — a collection of my learning, practical skills, activities, and projects.</p>
   <div class="actions"><button class="btn" data-go="about">Explore my portfolio ↗</button><button class="btn outline" data-go="works">View my works</button></div>
  </div>
  <div class="photo-frame"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Portrait of Necias T Bisnar Jr."><div class="photo-note">Curiosity · Creativity · Growth</div></div>
 </div>
</section>

<section class="page" id="about">
 <div class="pagehead"><div class="eyebrow">01 / Introduction</div><h2>About Me</h2><p>Get to know the student behind this portfolio.</p></div>
 <div class="grid2">
  <article class="panel"><div class="number">01</div><h3>Who I Am</h3><p>My name is Necias T Bisnar Jr. I am a student exploring the practical and creative lessons of Home Economics. I believe that learning useful life skills helps me become more independent, responsible, and prepared for the future.</p></article>
  <article class="panel"><div class="number">02</div><h3>My Purpose</h3><p>This portfolio presents my progress in H.E., including the activities I complete, the skills I practice, and the lessons I learn along the way. It also reminds me that improvement comes through patience and practice.</p></article>
  <article class="panel"><h3>My Interests</h3><p>Learning practical skills, discovering creative ideas, working with others, and finding better ways to complete everyday tasks.</p></article>
  <article class="panel"><h3>My Personal Goal</h3><p>To keep improving my abilities, take responsibility for my work, and apply what I learn at school to real-life situations.</p></article>
 </div>
</section>

<section class="page" id="skills">
 <div class="pagehead"><div class="eyebrow">02 / What I Am Learning</div><h2>H.E. Skills</h2><p>Home Economics develops practical abilities for daily living, work, and responsible decision-making.</p></div>
 <div class="grid2">
  <article class="panel"><h3>Practical Skills</h3>
   <div class="skill"><div class="skilltop"><span>Food preparation & kitchen safety</span><span>Learning</span></div><div class="track"><div class="fill" style="--w:72%"></div></div></div>
   <div class="skill"><div class="skilltop"><span>Proper hygiene & sanitation</span><span>Learning</span></div><div class="track"><div class="fill" style="--w:78%"></div></div></div>
   <div class="skill"><div class="skilltop"><span>Household organization</span><span>Learning</span></div><div class="track"><div class="fill" style="--w:70%"></div></div></div>
   <div class="skill"><div class="skilltop"><span>Basic clothing care</span><span>Learning</span></div><div class="track"><div class="fill" style="--w:65%"></div></div></div>
  </article>
  <article class="panel"><h3>Personal & Work Skills</h3><p>Skills I aim to strengthen through class activities and hands-on tasks:</p><span class="tag">Time management</span><span class="tag">Teamwork</span><span class="tag">Creativity</span><span class="tag">Communication</span><span class="tag">Problem-solving</span><span class="tag">Responsibility</span><span class="tag">Attention to detail</span><span class="tag">Resourcefulness</span></article>
 </div>
 <p style="font-size:12px;margin-top:14px">Note: Skill indicators are illustrative and can be edited to reflect your actual progress.</p>
</section>

<section class="page" id="works">
 <div class="pagehead"><div class="eyebrow">03 / Learning Evidence</div><h2>My Works</h2><p>A showcase area for class outputs, written activities, practical demonstrations, and other accomplishments.</p></div>
 <div class="literary-portfolio">
  <header class="literary-cover">
   <div class="eyebrow">Student Writing Collection</div>
   <h3>ENGLISH LITERARY PORTFOLIO</h3>
   <p><strong>Name:</strong> Necias T Bisnar Jr</p>
   <p><strong>Grade &amp; Section:</strong> 12 - H.E</p>
  </header>

  <article class="literary-section">
   <div class="section-label">I. ORIGINAL POEM</div>
   <h3>Little Steps, Big Dreams</h3>
   <div class="work-subtitle">An Original Poem</div>
   <div class="literary-poem">
    Every morning brings a light,<br>
    A chance to make our future bright.<br>
    Though the road may not be clear,<br>
    We move ahead despite our fear.<br><br>
    Some days are hard, some days are slow,<br>
    But every step helps us to grow.<br>
    With hope and courage in our heart,<br>
    We know that we can make a start.<br><br>
    Dreams may take a little time,<br>
    Like stars that slowly learn to shine.<br>
    So never stop and never fall,<br>
    Believe in yourself through it all.
   </div>
  </article>

  <article class="literary-section">
   <div class="section-label">II. SHORT STORY – FLASH FICTION</div>
   <h3>The Forgotten Notebook</h3>
   <div class="literary-copy">
    <p>One rainy afternoon, Mia found an old notebook under her classroom desk. It had no name, only a small message written on the first page: "Never give up on your dreams."</p>
    <p>Curious, she opened it and discovered pages filled with poems, drawings, and personal goals. The notebook seemed to belong to someone who once dreamed of becoming a writer.</p>
    <p>Mia asked her classmates if anyone recognized it, but nobody did. She decided to bring it to their teacher.</p>
    <p>The next day, their teacher announced that the notebook belonged to a former student who had returned to school to share her first published book.</p>
    <p>Mia smiled as she realized that even a forgotten notebook could carry a powerful story.</p>
    <p>From that day on, she started writing her own dreams in a notebook.</p>
   </div>
  </article>

  <article class="literary-section">
   <div class="section-label">III. LITERARY ANALYSIS ESSAY</div>
   <h3>The Importance of Hope in Literature</h3>
   <div class="literary-copy">
    <p>Hope is one of the most meaningful themes found in literature. It reminds readers that even during difficult times, there is always a reason to continue and believe in a better future.</p>
    <p>In the poem "Little Steps, Big Dreams," hope is presented as a source of strength. The speaker explains that reaching dreams takes patience, courage, and determination. The poem uses simple words to show that small efforts can lead to meaningful achievements.</p>
    <p>The flash fiction "The Forgotten Notebook" also presents the importance of hope. Mia discovers a notebook that inspires her to begin writing her own dreams. The notebook symbolizes inspiration and the courage to pursue personal goals.</p>
    <p>Both literary works teach readers that success does not happen immediately. It requires effort, patience, and belief in oneself.</p>
    <p>In conclusion, hope gives people the motivation to move forward. These works remind us that no dream is too small and every new beginning can lead to something meaningful.</p>
   </div>
  </article>

  <article class="literary-section">
   <div class="section-label">IV. REFLECTION PAPER</div>
   <h3>Learning Through Literature</h3>
   <div class="literary-copy">
    <p>Creating these literary works helped me understand the importance of creativity, imagination, and expressing emotions through writing.</p>
    <p>Writing the poem taught me that simple words can communicate meaningful messages. Creating a short story helped me develop my imagination and understand how a small event can teach an important lesson.</p>
    <p>Writing the literary analysis also helped me recognize the themes and messages behind different literary works. Meanwhile, the reflection paper allowed me to think about what I learned throughout the activity.</p>
    <p>This experience taught me that writing is not only about using beautiful words. It is also about sharing ideas, feelings, and lessons that other people can understand.</p>
    <p>Overall, I learned that literature helps us express ourselves and see life from different perspectives. I will continue improving my writing skills and use my creativity to create meaningful works.</p>
   </div>
  </article>

  <div class="literary-end">
   <strong>END OF PORTFOLIO</strong><br>
   Thank you for reading!
  </div>
 </div>
</section>

<section class="page" id="projects">
 <div class="pagehead"><div class="eyebrow">04 / Applied Learning</div><h2>Projects</h2><p>Projects help me turn classroom knowledge into useful and meaningful outputs.</p></div>
 <div class="grid2">
  <article class="panel"><div class="number">Project 01</div><h3>Everyday Living Skills</h3><p>A project concept focused on practicing useful routines, keeping a space organized, and completing household tasks responsibly.</p><span class="tag">Organization</span><span class="tag">Responsibility</span></article>
  <article class="panel"><div class="number">Project 02</div><h3>Food and Safety Awareness</h3><p>A learning project about cleanliness, safe food handling, proper preparation, and making thoughtful choices in the kitchen.</p><span class="tag">Food safety</span><span class="tag">Healthy habits</span></article>
 </div>
 <div class="panel" style="margin-top:18px"><h3>Project details</h3><p>For each completed project, add its date, objective, materials, steps, final output, and what you learned.</p></div>
</section>

<section class="page" id="reflection">
 <div class="pagehead"><div class="eyebrow">05 / Looking Back</div><h2>My Reflection</h2><p>Learning is not only about finishing an activity; it is also about understanding what the experience teaches me.</p></div>
 <article class="panel">
  <h3>What I Have Learned</h3>
  <p>Through Home Economics, I am learning that practical knowledge is important in everyday life. Simple tasks require preparation, patience, cleanliness, and responsibility. I also learned that following instructions and observing safety practices can help produce better results.</p>
  <h3 style="margin-top:25px">My Challenges and Growth</h3>
  <p>Some activities may be challenging at first, especially when they require new techniques or careful steps. Instead of giving up, I can improve by practicing, asking questions, and learning from mistakes.</p>
  <h3 style="margin-top:25px">My Next Step</h3>
  <p>I want to become more confident and independent in applying the skills I learn. I will continue to participate, stay open to feedback, and do my best in every activity.</p>
 </article>
</section>

<section class="page" id="resume">
 <div class="pagehead"><div class="eyebrow">06 / Student Profile</div><h2>Resume</h2><p>A simple student profile highlighting my education, strengths, and learning interests.</p></div>

<section class="page" id="contact">
 <div class="pagehead"><div class="eyebrow">07 / Get in Touch</div><h2>Contact</h2><p>Thank you for taking the time to view my H.E. student portfolio.</p></div>
 <div class="contactgrid">
  <div class="panel"><h3>Let's Connect</h3><p>For questions, feedback, or school-related concerns, you may use the message form.</p><p><strong style="color:var(--forest)">Name</strong><br>Necias T Bisnar Jr.</p><p><strong style="color:var(--forest)">Email</strong><br>Add your email address here</p><p><strong style="color:var(--forest)">School</strong><br>Add your school name here</p></div>
  <form class="panel contactform" id="contactForm"><h3>Send a Message</h3><label for="sender">Your name</label><input id="sender" required placeholder="Enter your name"><label for="email">Your email</label><input id="email" type="email" required placeholder="Enter your email"><label for="message">Message</label><textarea id="message" required placeholder="Write your message..."></textarea><button class="btn" type="submit" style="margin-top:16px">Prepare email ↗</button><p style="font-size:11px;margin-top:12px">This opens your email app. Set your email address in the code before using this form.</p></form>
 </div>
</section>
<div class="backtop"><span>NECIAS T BISNAR JR. · H.E. PORTFOLIO</span><span id="pageCount">01 / 08</span></div>
</main>
<footer>Designed as a student learning portfolio · 2026</footer>
<script>
const pages=[...document.querySelectorAll('.page')];
const navButtons=[...document.querySelectorAll('.navlinks button[data-page]')];
const nav=document.getElementById('navLinks');
const pageCount=document.getElementById('pageCount');
function openPage(id, push=true){
 const target=pages.find(p=>p.id===id)||pages[0];
 pages.forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle('active',p===target));
 navButtons.forEach((b,i)=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.page===target.id));
 pageCount.textContent=String(pages.indexOf(target)+1).padStart(2,'0')+' / 08';
 nav.classList.remove('open');
 if(push) history.pushState({page:target.id},'', '#'+target.id);
 window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
}
navButtons.forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>openPage(b.dataset.page)));
document.querySelectorAll('[data-go]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>openPage(b.dataset.go)));
document.getElementById('menuBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>nav.classList.toggle('open'));
window.addEventListener('popstate',()=>openPage(location.hash.slice(1)||'home',false));
openPage(location.hash.slice(1)||'home',false);
document.getElementById('contactForm').addEventListener('submit',e=>{
 e.preventDefault();
 const to='YOUR-EMAIL@example.com';
 const subject=encodeURIComponent('Portfolio message from '+document.getElementById('sender').value);
 const body=encodeURIComponent('From: '+document.getElementById('sender').value+' ('+document.getElementById('email').value+')\n\n'+document.getElementById('message').value);
 if(to==='YOUR-EMAIL@example.com'){alert('Please replace YOUR-EMAIL@example.com in the HTML code with your email address first.');return;}
 location.href='mailto:'+to+'?subject='+subject+'&body='+body;
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
